# Quantum Records and Coherence

Question and principal result: README.md
Connected scientific route and claim-to-proof map: science/README.md
Exact model, actual visibility and quantum/classical reduction: science/model.md
Independent endpoint, finite-size converse and sharp asymptotic coefficient: science/sharp-bound.md
Matching mixture and explicit linear-gate star circuit: science/constructions.md
Exactly pairwise-independent bounded-correlation construction: science/pairwise-independence.md
Physical interpretation and load-bearing limitations: science/scope.md
Attribution, Strasberg comparison, common-error budget calculation and unresolved Bavaro full text: references/related-work.md
Reproduction, checked scope and output: verification/README.md
Main executable checks and stored output: verification/check_records.py, verification/results.json
Common-error comparison check and stored output: verification/check_common_error.py, verification/common_error_results.json

Preserve these distinctions: selected fragments versus exhaustive pure environment;
actual visibility versus a compatible fidelity envelope or history probability-sum defect;
conditional errors versus average error; fixed-positive-budget asymptotics versus
varying-budget limits; pairwise versus joint independence; written proof versus
finite numerical checks; reconstructed mathematics versus verified priority.
Additional purifiers are explicitly outside the constrained record partition.
A perfectly correlated two-point family has a different correlation cost from the
independently noisy common-flip construction. The remaining inaccessible source
is Bavaro's manuscript v9.0, Zenodo 22647510, not the inspected Strasberg sections.
No educational anchor has been selected. No personal coaching procedure belongs
in this repository.
